controllers.name: serviceaccount-token-controller
controllers.rbacRole: none of its own (uses kube-controller-manager kubeconfig identity; bootstrap ClusterRole system:kube-controller-manager)
controllers.notes: Special controller (requiresSpecialHandling, cmd/kube-controller-manager/app/service_accounts.go:40-41) started first with the root (KCM's own) client builder (cmd/kube-controller-manager/app/controllermanager.go:264-266, 666-672, 821-825); it never uses a per-controller SA even with --use-service-account-credentials. Disabled (returns nil) unless --service-account-private-key-file is set (cmd/kube-controller-manager/app/service_accounts.go:49-52). Writes legacy SA token Secrets and updates ServiceAccounts to drop deleted secret refs (pkg/controller/serviceaccount/tokens_controller.go:359,439,455-483). policyKindRules listed here are those of the KCM identity role system:kube-controller-manager.

controllers.name: resourcequota-controller
controllers.notes: Writes ResourceQuota status (pkg/controller/resourcequota/resource_quota_controller.go:409). Wildcard rule is read-only (list/watch). apiGroups ['*'] x resources ['*'] matches every policy kind (namespaces, resourcequotas, limitranges, serviceaccounts, roles, rolebindings, clusterroles, clusterrolebindings, networkpolicies, VAP/VAPB, MAP/MAPB, validating/mutating webhook configurations, apiservices, customresourcedefinitions, certificatesigningrequests, flowschemas, prioritylevelconfigurations).

controllers.name: namespace-controller
controllers.notes: Deletes all content of terminating namespaces and finalizes them (pkg/controller/namespace/deletion/namespaced_resources_deleter.go:273,296,324,391); it discovers only namespaced resources (ServerPreferredNamespacedResources, cmd/kube-controller-manager/app/core.go:553), so in practice it deletes namespaced policy kinds (roles, rolebindings, resourcequotas, limitranges, serviceaccounts, networkpolicies, namespaced CRs) although the RBAC wildcard also covers cluster-scoped kinds. Client QPS x20 / burst x100 (cmd/kube-controller-manager/app/core.go:533-534). apiGroups ['*'] x resources ['*'] matches every policy kind (namespaces, resourcequotas, limitranges, serviceaccounts, roles, rolebindings, clusterroles, clusterrolebindings, networkpolicies, VAP/VAPB, MAP/MAPB, validating/mutating webhook configurations, apiservices, customresourcedefinitions, certificatesigningrequests, flowschemas, prioritylevelconfigurations).

controllers.name: serviceaccount-controller
controllers.notes: Creates the 'default' ServiceAccount in every namespace (pkg/controller/serviceaccount/serviceaccounts_controller.go:56-62,223).

controllers.name: garbage-collector-controller
controllers.notes: Deletes dependents / patches ownerReferences on any resource (pkg/controller/garbagecollector/operations.go:65,101). Constructor returns nil if EnableGarbageCollector=false (cmd/kube-controller-manager/app/core.go:643-645); default true (pkg/controller/garbagecollector/config/v1alpha1/defaults.go:34-35). RBAC-object updates by non-escalating users are allowed when only GC fields change (pkg/registry/rbac/helpers.go:29-50; pkg/registry/rbac/clusterrole/policybased/storage.go:93-105). apiGroups ['*'] x resources ['*'] matches every policy kind (namespaces, resourcequotas, limitranges, serviceaccounts, roles, rolebindings, clusterroles, clusterrolebindings, networkpolicies, VAP/VAPB, MAP/MAPB, validating/mutating webhook configurations, apiservices, customresourcedefinitions, certificatesigningrequests, flowschemas, prioritylevelconfigurations).

overwriteSemantics.markers: Every bootstrap object carries label kubernetes.io/bootstrapping=rbac-defaults and annotation rbac.authorization.kubernetes.io/autoupdate="true" (plugin/pkg/auth/authorizer/rbac/bootstrappolicy/policy.go:42-43,73-111; key constant staging/src/k8s.io/api/rbac/v1/types.go:38-39).
overwriteSemantics.protection: If an EXISTING object has annotation rbac.authorization.kubernetes.io/autoupdate == "false" it is Protected and left untouched (warning logged), including roleRef mismatches for bindings. Source: staging/src/k8s.io/component-helpers/auth/rbac/reconciliation/reconcile_role.go:134-137,181; reconcile_rolebindings.go:116-119,179; pkg/registry/rbac/rest/storage_rbac.go:221-222,251-252,284-285,316-317.
overwriteSemantics.rolesUnionOnly: Missing rules are appended; extra rules are NOT removed (RemoveExtraPermissions not set -> false; storage_rbac.go:209-213,272-276; reconcile_role.go:66-67,196-213).
overwriteSemantics.aggregation: Missing aggregation selectors are added; if the expected role has no aggregationRule but the existing one does, the aggregationRule is removed (reconcile_role.go:215-238).
overwriteSemantics.bindingsUnionOnly: Missing subjects are appended; extra subjects are kept (RemoveExtraSubjects not set; storage_rbac.go:239-243,304-308; reconcile_rolebindings.go:57-58,201-214).
overwriteSemantics.roleRefChange: If roleRef differs, the binding is deleted (UID precondition) and recreated from the bootstrap definition (reconcile_rolebindings.go:126-151,181-186).
overwriteSemantics.labelsAnnotations: Expected labels/annotations are merged with existing; existing values win on key conflict (reconcile_role.go:186-194,243-255; reconcile_rolebindings.go:191-199).
overwriteSemantics.deletedObjects: Missing objects are (re)created (ReconcileCreate on NotFound: reconcile_role.go:110-122; reconcile_rolebindings.go:97-104).
overwriteSemantics.priming: Before reconciling: copies legacy admin/edit/view into system:aggregate-to-* when those do not exist, and copies subjects of ClusterRoleBinding system:discovery into a new system:public-info-viewer binding if absent (storage_rbac.go:195-205,346-415; plugin/pkg/auth/authorizer/rbac/bootstrappolicy/policy.go:760-780).

bootstrapRoles.cadence: STARTUP_ONCE per kube-apiserver start: the hook polls every 1s for up to 30s until a full pass succeeds; failure kills the apiserver (storage_rbac.go:162-181; staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/server/hooks.go:195-206). No periodic re-reconciliation.
bootstrapRoles.identity: system:apiserver (UID random), groups [system:authenticated, system:masters] via the privileged loopback bearer token (staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/server/config.go:1206-1213, wired at :748; token = random UUID, staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/server/options/serving_with_loopback.go:92; hooks receive it via PostStartHookContext, staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/server/hooks.go:161-164)
bootstrapRoles.rbacWriteChecksBypassedByIdentity: The loopback identity is in system:masters, which skips RBAC escalation checks (pkg/registry/rbac/escalation_check.go:31-47) and is allowed by the privileged-group authorizer (pkg/kubeapiserver/authorizer/reload.go:110-115).
bootstrapRoles.aggregatedRoleRulesNote: admin/edit/view are aggregation-only ClusterRoles (plugin/pkg/auth/authorizer/rbac/bootstrappolicy/policy.go:390-419); their rules are filled continuously by the KCM clusterrole-aggregation-controller, not by this hook.

policyKindGrantsInDefaultClusterRoles.boundTo: nobody: ClusterRoleBinding system:node has no subjects (plugin/pkg/auth/authorizer/rbac/bootstrappolicy/policy.go:730-735); rules are used by the Node authorizer (pkg/kubeapiserver/authorizer/config.go:124)

bootstrapRoles.policyKindGrantsCrossCheck: Rule lists for controller and general ClusterRoles were cross-checked by parsing the golden fixtures (policyrules.py in this directory); no namespaced bootstrap Role has a policy-kind rule.

policyKindExemptions.webhooks: API-registered admission webhooks are never called for ValidatingWebhookConfiguration, MutatingWebhookConfiguration, ValidatingAdmissionPolicy(+Binding), MutatingAdmissionPolicy(+Binding); only static manifest-based webhooks may see them. policyKindExemptions.admissionPolicies: API-registered VAP/MAP are never evaluated for VAP/VAPB/MAP/MAPB objects (only static manifest policies are); they DO apply to webhook configurations and other policy kinds. policyKindExemptions.virtualResources: tokenreviews, selfsubjectreviews, (local|self)subjectaccessreviews, selfsubjectrulesreviews are excluded from all expression-based admission and, with ExcludeAdmissionWebhookVirtualResources (Beta, default on in 1.37), from webhooks. serviceaccounts/token is explicitly INCLUDED. Source: pkg/kubeapiserver/admission/exclusion/resources.go:30-54; pkg/controlplane/apiserver/admission/config.go:51-54; staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/admission/plugin/webhook/generic/webhook.go:197-205,394-399; ExcludeAdmissionWebhookVirtualResources spec staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/features/kube_features.go:400-402 (relisted pkg/features/kube_features.go:2408-2410)
policyKindExemptions.manifestBasedConfig: ManifestBasedAdmissionControlConfig is Beta and default ON in 1.37 (staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/features/kube_features.go:415-418; relisted pkg/features/kube_features.go:2423-2426); it lets webhooks and VAP/MAP be loaded from manifest files (staticManifestsDir) at startup, with file reload (staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/features/kube_features.go:182-189; pkg/kubeapiserver/admission/initializer.go:53-87; staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/admission/plugin/policy/generic/plugin.go:255-275).

admissionPlugins.csrApprovalSigningEnforcement: CertificateApproval requires verb 'approve' on signers/<signerName> for updates to certificatesigningrequests/approval; CertificateSigning requires 'sign' for certificatesigningrequests/status (plugin/pkg/admission/certificates/approval/admission.go:78,91; plugin/pkg/admission/certificates/signing/admission.go:81,100); ClusterTrustBundleAttest requires 'attest' (plugin/pkg/admission/certificates/ctbattest/admission.go:119).

nodeAuthorizer.identification: A request is a node iff username has prefix 'system:node:' AND groups contain 'system:nodes'; nodeName = suffix (pkg/auth/nodeidentifier/default.go:36-66; constants staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/authentication/user/user.go:72).
nodeAuthorizer.construction: Node authorizer = graph + NodeRules() static rules (pkg/kubeapiserver/authorizer/config.go:104-124).

policyKindPermissions.scope: only for (namespace,name) ServiceAccounts reachable in the graph from the node, i.e. referenced by pod.spec.serviceAccountName of a pod bound to the node

same graph restriction; only when KubeletServiceAccountTokenForCredentialProviders (Beta, default on since 1.34: pkg/features/kube_features.go:1808-1811) or PodCertificateRequest (GA, default on in 1.37) is enabled
NOT graph-limited: allowed by the static NodeRules (any CSR object)

nodeAuthorizer.notGranted: Nodes receive no rules for namespaces, resourcequotas, limitranges, roles/rolebindings/clusterroles/clusterrolebindings, networkpolicies, VAP/MAP(+bindings), webhook configurations, apiservices, customresourcedefinitions, CSR approval/signing (approve/sign on signers), impersonate, escalate or bind (full NodeRules list plugin/pkg/auth/authorizer/rbac/bootstrappolicy/policy.go:214-312; golden plugin/pkg/auth/authorizer/rbac/bootstrappolicy/testdata/cluster-roles.yaml role system:node).
nodeAuthorizer.staticRuleNotReachedForServiceAccounts: NodeRules contains create serviceaccounts/token (plugin/pkg/auth/authorizer/rbac/bootstrappolicy/policy.go:266-268) and get serviceaccounts (plugin/pkg/auth/authorizer/rbac/bootstrappolicy/policy.go:300-304), but serviceaccounts requests are always routed to the graph check first (node_authorizer.go:150-151), so these static rules never apply unrestricted.
nodeAuthorizer.nodeRestrictionAdmission: With NodeRestriction enabled (off by default in kube-apiserver), node TokenRequests must be bound to a Pod (apiVersion v1, kind Pod, name+uid) scheduled on that node, plus audience validation when ServiceAccountNodeAudienceRestriction is on (Beta, default on since 1.33: pkg/features/kube_features.go:2131-2134). Source: plugin/pkg/admission/noderestriction/admission.go:182,186,233,248,672-715
nodeAuthorizer.rbacBinding: ClusterRoleBinding system:node exists with zero subjects, so nodes get nothing from RBAC by default (plugin/pkg/auth/authorizer/rbac/bootstrappolicy/policy.go:730-735).
nodeAuthorizer.otherGraphLimitedResources: secrets/configmaps (get/list/watch), pvc (get; status update/patch), pv, resourceclaims, volumeattachments (get), leases in kube-node-lease (own name), csinodes, resourceslices, nodes, pods, podcertificaterequests (plugin/pkg/auth/authorizer/node/node_authorizer.go:132-167).

authorizationConfig.gaStatus: No feature-gate check guards --authorization-config in v1.37.1 (authorization.go:103-121,217-233), and the string 'StructuredAuthorizationConfiguration' does not occur anywhere in the v1.37.1 tree (whole-tree grep), i.e. the gate has been removed after graduation. The release in which it went GA cannot be determined from this tree (see unverified).
authorizationConfig.defaultWithoutFlags: If neither --authorization-config nor --authorization-mode is set, the mode defaults to AlwaysAllow (authorization.go:85-94).
authorizationConfig.reloadMechanics: Only when --authorization-config is used: ReloadFile is set (authorization.go:241-249) and Config.New starts runReload (pkg/kubeapiserver/authorizer/config.go:157-159) with reloadInterval = 1 minute (config.go:92). runReload uses filesystem.WatchUntil = fsnotify events plus polling every interval (pkg/kubeapiserver/authorizer/reload.go:231-246; staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/util/filesystem/watchuntil.go:38-90). checkFile re-reads, skips if bytes unchanged, validates, requires every non-webhook authorizer type present at startup to remain (config.go:142-144,217-219), rebuilds and atomically swaps the authorizer chain; on error the old chain stays (reload.go:248-292). Node/ABAC/RBAC cannot be added on reload if not enabled at startup (reload.go:120-123,143-146,199-202). Legacy --authorization-mode flags are converted to an in-memory AuthorizationConfiguration with no reload (authorization.go:234-239,252-...).
authorizationConfig.systemMastersAlwaysFirst: Every built chain (initial and reloaded) prepends authorizer 'kubernetes.io/system-privileged-group' allowing group system:masters (pkg/kubeapiserver/authorizer/reload.go:110-115).
authorizationConfig.rbacHookCoupling: If RBAC is not among the configured authorizers, the rbac/bootstrap-roles hook is disabled (pkg/controlplane/apiserver/config.go:241-243,273-279).

validatingAdmissionPolicy.status: GA: no ValidatingAdmissionPolicy feature gate exists in pkg/features or the apiserver feature list (grep found none; full apiserver gate map staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/features/kube_features.go:320-502); VAP/VAPB are served at admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1 (pkg/registry/admissionregistration/rest/storage_apiserver.go:100-119) which is enabled by default (pkg/controlplane/instance.go:462-472); the admission plugin is unconditionally enabled (staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/admission/plugin/policy/validating/plugin.go:137) and default-on (pkg/kubeapiserver/options/plugins.go:188); the KCM status controller has no required gates (cmd/kube-controller-manager/app/validatingadmissionpolicystatus.go:33-39).

mutatingAdmissionPolicy.status: GA since 1.36, default true, not locked (staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/features/kube_features.go:420-424; relisted pkg/features/kube_features.go:2428-2432); served in admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1 (pkg/registry/admissionregistration/rest/storage_apiserver.go:120-139); plugin enabled iff gate (staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/admission/plugin/policy/mutating/plugin.go:163-164).

bypasses: Authorization: privileged-group authorizer always first, allows everything (pkg/kubeapiserver/authorizer/reload.go:110-115).

RBAC escalation/bind checks skipped (EscalationAllowed) for role/binding writes (pkg/registry/rbac/escalation_check.go:31-47; used in pkg/registry/rbac/{role,clusterrole,rolebinding,clusterrolebinding}/policybased/storage.go).
Also bound to cluster-admin by bootstrap ClusterRoleBinding (plugin/pkg/auth/authorizer/rbac/bootstrappolicy/policy.go:719).
APF: mandatory FlowSchema 'exempt' (matchingPrecedence 1) maps group system:masters to the exempt priority level (staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/apis/flowcontrol/bootstrap/default.go:110-137).
system:masters.note: No system:masters-specific skip was found in the admission dispatch paths read (staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/admission/plugin/webhook/generic/webhook.go:409-425; staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/admission/plugin/policy/generic/plugin.go:302-335); the resource-based exemptions under admissionPlugins.policyKindExemptions apply to every requester.

builtInIdentities.system:apiserver: Loopback identity: user system:apiserver, groups system:authenticated + system:masters, random UID, authenticated by a per-process random bearer token (staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/server/config.go:1189-1217,748; staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/server/options/serving_with_loopback.go:92). Used by all in-process writers listed in apiserverWriters.
builtInIdentities.system:kube-controller-manager: Bound to ClusterRole system:kube-controller-manager (plugin/pkg/auth/authorizer/rbac/bootstrappolicy/policy.go:490-511,725) and kube-system RoleBindings system::leader-locking-kube-controller-manager and system::extension-apiserver-authentication-reader (plugin/pkg/auth/authorizer/rbac/bootstrappolicy/namespace_policy.go:124-130). The username comes from the KCM's kubeconfig credential (kubeadm: client cert CN system:kube-controller-manager, cmd/kubeadm/app/phases/kubeconfig/kubeconfig.go:511; cmd/kubeadm/app/constants/constants.go:170).
builtInIdentities.system:kube-scheduler: Bound to system:kube-scheduler and system:volume-scheduler (plugin/pkg/auth/authorizer/rbac/bootstrappolicy/policy.go:727-728) plus kube-system RoleBindings (plugin/pkg/auth/authorizer/rbac/bootstrappolicy/namespace_policy.go:124-126,131-132). Policy-kind access: get/list/watch namespaces only (plugin/pkg/auth/authorizer/rbac/bootstrappolicy/policy.go:659).
builtInIdentities.system:kube-proxy: Bound to system:node-proxier (plugin/pkg/auth/authorizer/rbac/bootstrappolicy/policy.go:724); rules plugin/pkg/auth/authorizer/rbac/bootstrappolicy/policy.go:615-630 contain no policy kinds.
builtInIdentities.system:nodes / system:node:<name>: No RBAC grants by default (system:node binding has no subjects: plugin/pkg/auth/authorizer/rbac/bootstrappolicy/policy.go:730-735); authorized by the Node authorizer when Node mode is configured (see nodeAuthorizer).
builtInIdentities.serviceAccountsGroup: Group system:serviceaccounts is bound to system:service-account-issuer-discovery and system:cluster-trust-bundle-discovery (plugin/pkg/auth/authorizer/rbac/bootstrappolicy/policy.go:746-753); no policy kinds.
builtInIdentities.impersonation: ConstrainedImpersonation is Beta and default ON since 1.36 (staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/features/kube_features.go:367-370; relisted pkg/features/kube_features.go:2375-2378); the handler chain then uses WithConstrainedImpersonation (staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/server/config.go:1055-1059), which tries modes associated-node, arbitrary-node, serviceaccount, user-info (verbs impersonate:<mode> plus secondary impersonate-on:<mode>:<verb>) and finally legacy verb 'impersonate' on users/groups/serviceaccounts/userextras/uids (staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/endpoints/filters/impersonation/mode.go:60-68,247-259,548-557; impersonation.go:76-110).

ensureSemantics.mandatory: exempt + catch-all PLCs and FlowSchemas: spec always forced back to bootstrap (alwaysAutoUpdateSpec=true) (pkg/registry/flowcontrol/ensurer/strategy.go:149-155; staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/apis/flowcontrol/bootstrap/default.go:34-43).
ensureSemantics.suggested: system, node-high, leader-election, workload-high, workload-low, global-default PLCs and 9 suggested FlowSchemas (default.go:46-82) are updated only if annotation apf.kubernetes.io/autoupdate-spec parses true, or (annotation missing/unparsable and metadata.generation == 1) (strategy.go:141-147,199-217; key staging/src/k8s.io/api/flowcontrol/v1/types.go:103).
ensureSemantics.recreate: Any missing bootstrap object is always re-created (strategy.go:252-275).
ensureSemantics.deleteDangling: Objects annotated apf.kubernetes.io/autoupdate-spec=true whose names are not in the bootstrap set are deleted; objects without the annotation are skipped (strategy.go:306-334; storage_flowcontrol.go:211-229).

apiPriorityAndFairness.systemMastersExempt: Mandatory FlowSchema 'exempt' (precedence 1) routes group system:masters to the exempt level; suggested FlowSchema 'probes' exempts GET /healthz,/readyz,/livez for everyone (staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/apis/flowcontrol/bootstrap/default.go:110-137,282-293).
apiPriorityAndFairness.rbacNote: No bootstrap role other than cluster-admin and the wildcard controller roles above grants writes to flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io (policyrules.py cross-check of testdata/*.yaml).

escalate.enforcement: Create/update of Roles/ClusterRoles is allowed if requester is in system:masters, OR holds verb 'escalate' on that roles/clusterroles object, OR already holds every rule being granted (ConfirmNoEscalation). Updates that only change GC fields skip the check. Setting/changing an aggregationRule needs '*' on '*.*'. Source: pkg/registry/rbac/escalation_check.go:31-98; pkg/registry/rbac/clusterrole/policybased/storage.go:68-122; pkg/registry/rbac/role/policybased/storage.go:68,74,81,94; pkg/registry/rbac/helpers.go:29-50

bind.enforcement: Create/update of RoleBindings/ClusterRoleBindings is allowed if requester is in system:masters, OR holds verb 'bind' on the referenced role/clusterrole (checked in the binding's namespace, '' for ClusterRoleBindings), OR already holds every rule of the referenced role. Source: pkg/registry/rbac/escalation_check.go:100-140; pkg/registry/rbac/rolebinding/policybased/storage.go:70-96,103-137; pkg/registry/rbac/clusterrolebinding/policybased/storage.go:70-88,95-122
bootstrapHolders: cluster-admin via verb '*' only (no bootstrap role names 'bind'; golden-fixture cross-check)

impersonate.enforcement: See builtInIdentities.impersonation (ConstrainedImpersonation Beta default-on; legacy 'impersonate' on users/groups/serviceaccounts/userextras/uids still honored).

bootstrapHolders: system:node rules, graph-limited by the Node authorizer (plugin/pkg/auth/authorizer/rbac/bootstrappolicy/policy.go:266-268; plugin/pkg/auth/authorizer/node/node_authorizer.go:265-288)
createServiceAccountsToken.admission: serviceaccounts/token is explicitly included for expression-based admission (pkg/kubeapiserver/admission/exclusion/resources.go:38-39).
createServiceAccountsToken.newIn1_37: APIServerWebhookAuthenticationToken (Alpha, default off: staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/features/kube_features.go:331-333; relisted pkg/features/kube_features.go:2339-2341) allows TokenRequests bound to ValidatingWebhookConfiguration/MutatingWebhookConfiguration objects; it additionally requires verb 'attest' on authentication.k8s.io resource 'admissionReviewAPIGroups' (name = requested group) for the ServiceAccount, rejects kube-apiserver audiences and caps expiry at 600s (pkg/registry/core/serviceaccount/storage/token.go:55,230-262,312-341; staging/src/k8s.io/api/authentication/v1/types.go:68).

specialVerbs.csrApproveSign: Verbs 'approve'/'sign' on certificates.k8s.io signers/<signerName> are enforced by the default-on CertificateApproval/CertificateSigning admission plugins (see admissionPlugins.csrApprovalSigningEnforcement).

identities: controller-manager.conf client cert CN system:kube-controller-manager (cmd/kubeadm/app/phases/kubeconfig/kubeconfig.go:511; constants.go:170)

unverified: Nothing was executed against a running cluster; all statements come from static reading of v1.37.1 sources. Object counts for bootstrap RBAC come from the unit-test golden fixtures, which assume default feature gates.

The release in which StructuredAuthorizationConfiguration (--authorization-config) and ValidatingAdmissionPolicy reached GA is not recorded in the v1.37.1 tree (gates removed; no CHANGELOG mention found by grep). Only 'GA, gate removed, unconditional' is verified.
The KCM identity's username depends on the credential in its --kubeconfig; only kubeadm's choice (CN=system:kube-controller-manager) was verified. Managed distributions (e.g. GKE) were not examined.

Inference, not verified: with the binary default --use-service-account-credentials=false, the bootstrap system:kube-controller-manager ClusterRole alone lacks the write permissions most controllers need (e.g. pods create/delete), so such deployments must give the KCM a broader identity.
ConstrainedImpersonation mode details were only partially read (mode list and verb shapes); per-mode authorization semantics beyond the cited lines were not traced.
